<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

The Java agent no longer adds `thread.id` and `thread.name` to spans by default. To get them back:

```
otel.javaagent.add-thread-details=true
```


- **`AgentDistributionConfig`**: the flat default for `otel.javaagent.add-thread-details` is now `false`, with no dependence on `otel.instrumentation.common.v3-preview`. Explicit `true` and `false` still work, and declarative config is unchanged.
- **`ThreadDetailsCustomizerProviderTest`** (new): covers the flat config when the setting is absent, `true` and `false`.
- **`AbstractSpringBootSmokeTest`**: removes the `thread.id` and `thread.name` presence assertions and their imports. It adds no absence assertions.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`**: adds a breaking-change note for the new default.
metadata.title: Make agent thread details opt-in for 3.0
